structurePatterns: vertical stack: label -> control -> helper/counter with 6px gaps
control is an outlined rounded box with 88px min height and 8/12 padding
optional character counter sits right-aligned below the control in tertiary color
error swaps border to danger and shows danger helper text
usageHints: counter is optional and must not be the only error signal
readonly stays visually distinct from disabled
resize is vertical-only or disabled on mobile
doNotInvent: no auto-grow beyond 160px visible without scroll on compact
